title.narrative: Community rehabilitation & socio economic activities as response to psychosocial programme

description.narrative:
It is an association of genocide widows created in 1995, in partnership with CAFOD since 1996. It aims to promote the integration of the widows and strengthen their self-promotion and participation in the process of development in Rwanda.
As part of the exit period of CAFOD funding, the AVEGA project in 2012 is mainly training and supervision of psychosocial animators, individual and group counselling. AVEGA will be conducting activities aiming at the social integration of the population affected by trauma, social cohesion and reconciliation through community based approaches. The programme also contains other activities aiming at reducing the vulnerability of women and children mostly orphans with the objective of increasing access to justice. Finally, the project will put in place a mechanism of sustaining the results of previous projects by reinforcing the capacities of APS and psychosocial animators, so they can take care of beneficiaries after CAFOD withdrawal.
The main activities planned in 2012 are: technical supervision and refresher courses for 300 APS, clinical supervision of 16 counsellors, and initiate income generating activities for beneficiaries.
